notes.title: About Heaven vs Hell
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello, guys![/b][/h1]
I am a developer of this awesome tiny strategy game. What is [b]Heaven vs Hell[/b] and why it is so special for me and, hopefully, will be for you too?
Well, i am a fan of strategy games myself, especially RTS. But one game that really inspired to me make [b]Heaven vs Hell[/b] was a turn-based classic [b]"Desciples"[/b]. It was a really great expierience for me and i wanted to make my own version of that mechanic, but add a fun twist to it.
So here it is - you can call it a [u]semi[/u]-turn-based game, where you can play as cute angels or terribly cute demons in a battle for a [b]Heaven Nimbus[/b] - a source of unlimited strength.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37563112/0c232d7f008c9efd21be53a44e845159643b3ae8.png[/img]

Here you gather your army of different unit types and controll it in realtime, but each one has "initiative" parameter and it will attack only when it is full regenerated. Basically now, you have to manage time too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37563112/bb93ff1f3a28d9e9861c918daff4ca1285a9eb8d.png[/img]

Well, you just need to try it and see how fun it is! Thats why you will have a wonderful chance to play [b]Heaven vs Hell[/b] demo where you will beat pesky demons (and some other creepy enemies), and even a [b]Giant Chtulhu[/b]!

Enjoy our [b]Heaven vs Hell[/b] demo!
